ukmt-tmc-2024-regional-crossnumber-01.prompt:
Complete the crossnumber. Each answer is a whole number whose digits fill the squares of the grid (the number in brackets is the number of digits); no answer starts with 0. Some clues refer to other answers.

**Across**

1. Sum of 11 Down and $\frac14$ of (2 Down $\times$ 21 Across) (4)
3. A power of 8 (3)
5. The number of different arrangements of the letters in the word MATHS (3)
7. A Fibonacci number (2)
9. A palindromic number (3)
11. One more than 22 Down (3)
13. The sum of 10 Down and the square root of 17 Across (2)
15. The remainder when 8 Down is divided by 200 (2)
16. An angle, in degrees, of an isosceles triangle that has $76^\circ$ as one of its angles (2)
17. The square root of 12 Down (2)
18. A multiple of 5 (3)
21. A multiple of both 3 and 37 (3)
23. The sum of 3 Down and the final digit of 8 Down (2)
25. The difference between 8 Down and 28 Across (3)
27. The value of $\left(\frac{3\text{ Down}}{2}-2\right)^2$ (3)
28. A power of 5 (4)

**Down**

1. Half of 21 Across (3)
2. The remainder when 25 Across is divided by 50 (2)
3. Twice 17 Across (2)
4. A prime number (2)
6. The difference between 21 Across and 9 Across (3)
8. A power of 8 (4)
10. The number of different arrangements of the letters in the word UKMT (2)
11. The sum of 22 Down and a square number (3)
12. A power of 5 (3)
14. The sum of 28 Across and ($4\times$ 17 Across) (4)
19. An angle, in degrees, of an isosceles triangle that has $31.5^\circ$ as one of its angles (3)
20. Four times the mean of the integers from 1 to 16 (2)
22. One less than 11 Across (3)
24. One more than the square root of 8 Down (2)
25. The value of $x^2+2x$ where $x$ is an integer (2)
26. A prime number (2)
